subject: Marketplace PO intake: cross-cloud billing mapping & onboarding steps
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@stratify.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@stratify.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Marketplace onboarding + PO routing (Stratify AI)

Hi Jonas / Lauren —

Thanks for taking the meeting last week. We're ready to proceed with listing Stratify AI on the three cloud marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure). Finance needs a clear PO path and the onboarding packet so we can wire first-month marketplace fees and enable billing integration.

Quick facts:
- Stripe is not an option for us; AP team prefers PO wiring.
- We will be the marketplace seller (publisher) and need the vendor-side billing mapping to our accounting entity.
- Estimated first invoice: $52,400 (monthly) — will be submitted as a PO.

Can you send the exact PO fields you require, the preferred PO upload method (portal vs. email), and any seller onboarding forms we should complete? Also confirm if Redwood needs a separate marketplace legal addendum per cloud.

Attachments: none (we'll attach PO once we have the intake details).

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Head of Finance | Stratify AI
M: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Marta Lopez <marta@stratify.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace onboarding + PO routing (Stratify AI)

Marta —

Thanks — welcome aboard. High-level next steps below so your AP team can prepare:

1) We need a formal PO that includes: vendor legal name, billing address, Redwood invoice remit-to (we'll provide), PO number, line items (we'll give SKU list), billing frequency, and a contact email for escalation.
2) Preferred upload method: For AWS/Azure/GCP we accept PO PDFs via our Procurement Portal (preferred) or you can send to procurement@redwood.ai for manual intake. Portal link will be included by Lauren.
3) Seller onboarding form: we have a short seller intake spreadsheet that captures tax, bank details, and marketplace listing metadata. Lauren will attach the form.
4) Marketplace addendum: In most cases we handle a standard marketplace routing addendum — legal will flag any cloud-specific language. For now, send the PO and onboarding form; we'll triage legal if anything unusual appears.

Vanessa / Lauren — please add the portal link and the current seller intake sheet. Laura(n) — copying you as procurement owner for marketplace flows.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Marta Lopez <marta@stratify.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace onboarding + PO routing (Stratify AI)

Hi Marta / Jonas —

Attaching the seller intake spreadsheet and the portal upload instructions. Summary below so your AP team has a compact checklist: 

Portal vs Email
- Portal (preferred): https://procurement.redwood.ai/portal — upload a single PDF named {PO_NUMBER}_Stratify_PO.pdf and select "Marketplace Activation". Portal sends automatic ack and routes to finance.
- Email (fallback): procurement@redwood.ai — include subject: "PO Upload: STRATIFY / MARKETPLACE" and attach the PDF. Email intake may add 24–48h processing.

Required PO fields (minimum):
- PO number
- Vendor legal name and billing address
- Redwood remit-to address: Redwood Inference, 112 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105 (we'll include W-9 reference)
- Line items + unit price + quantity + SKU if known
- Billing frequency (monthly/quarterly)
- AP contact email and phone

Onboarding attachments we need:
- Seller_Onboarding_Form_Strify.xlsx (attached)
- Signed marketplace addendum (if applicable) — we'll draft if you prefer to sign our standard version
- W-9 or foreign equivalent

Processing SLAs: once we receive a complete PO + onboarding form, expected processing to activation on marketplaces is 5–7 business days (assuming no legal/AML holds). If you need accelerated activation, mark the portal upload: "expedite" and cc vanessa_ortiz.

Attachments: Seller_Onboarding_Form_Strify.xlsx (form), portal-instructions.pdf (stub)

—Lauren Bishop
Procurement Program Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Thanks — I confirm receipt of STR-482 and the completed onboarding sheet. Next actions: 

- Lauren / Finance to map the PO to marketplace SKUs and create the invoice remit profile (vanessa, please confirm once the billing entity is set).
- Legal will review the standard marketplace addendum; if clean, we will request a counter-signature (no blocker expected).
- Estimated marketplace activation window: 3 business days from finance mapping.

Marta — we pushed the portal upload through and marked expedite. You should see an activation ticket in the portal and a HubSpot record at https://hubspot.example/record/STR-482.

If anything changes on your end (tax docs or entity mapping), flag procurement@redwood.ai with subject "PO Amendment: STR-482".

Welcome to Redwood — excited to get you listed.
